title: Ollama Local AI with Microsoft.Extensions.AI
description: Run local LLMs and embedding models with Ollama and Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Ollama for private or offline RAG backends.

blocks.text: Ollama lets you run LLMs locally without sending data to external APIs. Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Ollama bridges Ollama models to the same IChatClient and IEmbeddingGenerator abstractions used by cloud providers.

blocks.title: Prerequisites
items: Install Ollama from ollama.com and run `ollama serve`.
Pull a model: `ollama pull llama3` or `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`.

blocks.title: Ollama chat and embeddings
blocks.content: Use Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Ollama for local chat and embedding generation.

blocks.title: Local models for development
blocks.text: Ollama is ideal for development, testing, and privacy-sensitive workloads. Production RAG usually benefits from larger or specialized models hosted in Azure or OpenAI.

items.text: I can run Ollama and pull a model
items.hint: ollama serve and ollama pull llama3

items.text: I can create IChatClient with OllamaChatClient

items.hint: Use OllamaEmbeddingGenerator with a local embedding model

blocks.title: Lesson Summary
points: Ollama provides local LLMs and embedding models.
Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Ollama maps Ollama to IChatClient and IEmbeddingGenerator.
Local models are useful for development, testing, and offline scenarios.
blocks.takeaway: Use Ollama with Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Ollama when you need local or offline AI inference in .NET.
